subject: station/economy.py -- VRB-05 BUY/SELL, the cross-place money pump
gate: python3 station/economy.py --trade && ! python3 station/economy.py --break-crossplace && ! python3 station/economy.py --break-margin

craft.why: The verb set reads as a market rather than a pair of functions: a shopfront pays BUY_BACK, a fence pays FENCE_TAKE of that and is the only buyer for a sealed line, and the round trip is a loss everywhere on the station. Not a 4: SELL has no engine-side prompt -- interact.counter_offer bakes prices and not bids, and interact.py/interact.gd are not this agent's files.

fidelity.why: No new constant. The clamp is the law of one price applied to a closed market whose diameter is a walk, and both ratios (BUY_BACK 0.5, FENCE_TAKE 0.75) were already derived in this file for other purposes. The fence stays the mechanic FACTIONS 11.4 describes. INV-1015/1016.

performance.why: shelf_floor is one pass over the register per seed, memoised; cross_pump over 65 goods x 129 places is 0.2 s. The whole --trade gate including the launched shipped writer is 8.4 s standalone, 25 s for gate + both controls.

robustness.why: Two negative controls, both shown firing. The station-wide assertion fails on CONTENT rather than on an author's knob. Still red: VRB-005 as a spec row, because CAST-41 files Solly Vane at `subfloor_stack` and the register gives that place no trading function -- a one-tuple edit in directory.py, which this agent does not own.
